purpose: test a properly role-integrated, episode-conditioned competing-transition challenger after rejected WP4A global hazard and WP4B FSM/CUSUM, without rewriting either historical result

prior_results_preserved.WP4C: FORMATION_MONITORING_SIGNAL_REPRODUCED_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED; structural-health/anatomy lane remains separate from independent prediction

authority_basis.reference: Putter, Fiocco & Geskus (2007), Tutorial in biostatistics: competing risks and multi-state models
authority_basis.use: model intermediate states and competing transitions rather than collapsing all behavior into one undifferentiated next-origin event

authority_basis.reference: Jackson (2011), Multi-State Models for Panel Data: The msm Package for R
authority_basis.use: time-varying covariates may modify state-transition intensities while retaining an explicit state process

authority_basis.reference: Riley et al. (2019), Minimum sample size for developing a multivariable prediction model: PART II
authority_basis.use: small event support constrains predictor complexity; therefore the primary learned model is deliberately low-dimensional and strongly regularized

authority_basis.reference: Heinze & Schemper (2002), A solution to the problem of separation in logistic regression
authority_basis.use: small-sample/separation risk is acknowledged; this preregistration uses strong fixed shrinkage and permits INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT rather than rescue tuning

episode_definition.opener: WP4C structural-health/tactical monitoring opener: PATH_HALF OR FAST_CONFLICT
episode_definition.structural_health_interpretation: PATH_HALF is current-condition/anatomy monitoring only and is not an independent predictor in the BREAK-vs-RECOVERY probability model
episode_definition.start_rule: an episode starts at the first governed origin where opener is true and no primary break is already occurring on that same origin
episode_definition.break_terminal: first later governed origin inside the open episode carrying the frozen primary k=3 break label
episode_definition.recovery_terminal: first governed origin after episode start where opener is false before a break occurs
episode_definition.same_origin_break_at_episode_open: excluded from predictive episode scoring because the outcome is already contemporaneously observable
episode_definition.right_censoring: an episode still open at formation end is censored and excluded from binary proper-score evaluation

governed_identity_role_ledger.CAUSAL_PATCH: monthly H1 expert; strategic context extension only, never a daily trigger
governed_identity_role_ledger.VW_MIDAS_MSVR_SUCCESSOR_V1: monthly H1 expert; strategic context extension only, never a daily trigger
governed_identity_role_ledger.MOMENTUM_3M: monthly H1 expert; strategic context extension only, never a daily trigger
governed_identity_role_ledger.RANDOM_WALK: monthly H1 benchmark/anchor for strategic context, never a daily trigger
governed_identity_role_ledger.FAST: episode tactical evidence and severity; FAST_OPPOSITE is a learned core feature
governed_identity_role_ledger.SLOW: confirmation/new-regime lane; not forced into early BREAK-vs-RECOVERY probability merely to make all engines vote
governed_identity_role_ledger.MACRO_EVENT_SUCCESSOR_V2: event-clock modifier represented by chronology-safe mapped strong macro event context; not a continuous daily vote
governed_identity_role_ledger.BOCPD_RETURN_SUCCESSOR_V1: native completed-month regime context; no direction vote
governed_identity_role_ledger.EMERGENCY_LEVEL: same-origin extension on AVAILABLE_FROZEN_REFERENCE support only
governed_identity_role_ledger.EMERGENCY_REVERSAL: same-origin high-specificity extension on AVAILABLE_FROZEN_REFERENCE support only
governed_identity_role_ledger.GVZ_RISK: architecture slot retained but primary 2022-2024 formation use is NOT_TESTABLE until PIT history is proven; no imputation and no core-window shortening

primary_models.note: No adverse_fraction/PATH_HALF value enters this probability model. Structural health opens the monitored episode but cannot rescue predictive probability scoring.

same_origin_extensions.eligibility: all four frozen historical-replay H1 experts available at the episode start
same_origin_extensions.comparison: M2 core refit and evaluated on the exact same eligible episodes versus M2 plus this one feature
same_origin_extensions.promotion_role: context extension only; cannot become daily trigger

same_origin_extensions.comparison: M2 core refit and evaluated on the exact same eligible episodes versus M2 plus the emergency features
same_origin_extensions.promotion_role: selective context/confirmation extension only; not an OR trigger

same_origin_extensions.current_preregistered_action_if_unproven: NOT_TESTABLE; do not impute, do not shorten the core window, do not block the core study

slow_confirmation_lane.reason: forcing a completed-week confirmation engine into an early episode-conversion vote would violate the manifest role lock
slow_confirmation_lane.report: carry forward the governed formation confirmation statistic and verify it from frozen evidence; do not optimize it inside WP4D

prequential_protocol.training_episode_rule: only episodes whose terminal transition occurred strictly before the current episode start may train the current prediction

formation_decision_rule.required_vs_null: M2 must strictly improve both Brier score and log loss versus M0 on the exact same common prequential scored episodes
formation_decision_rule.required_vs_minimal: M2 must be no worse than M1 on both Brier score and log loss and strictly improve at least one of the two

extension_retention_rule.retain_as_empirically_supported_modifier: extension must be no worse than same-support M2 core on both Brier and log loss and strictly improve at least one
extension_retention_rule.otherwise: retain architecture role as context-only or NOT_TESTABLE; do not delete the governed identity and do not use the extension to rescue M2

challenge_rule_if_formation_passes.challenge_success_interpretation: ACCEPT_INTEGRATED_MONITORING_CORE_SUPPORTED; not production authority and not prospective validation
